spec.name: WhatsApp Neo API
spec.description:
REST API for WhatsApp via whatsapp-web.js + remote Chromium CDP.

All routes except `/health` require one of:
- X-Api-Token: <API_TOKEN>
- Authorization: Basic <base64>
- Authorization: Bearer <JWT>

See the Auth section for how to obtain a JWT via /auth/login or /auth/signup.

bearerAuth.name: X-Api-Token
bearerAuth.description: API_TOKEN from .env — set in X-Api-Token request header

basicAuth.description: BASIC_AUTH_USERNAME / BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD from .env — standard HTTP Basic Auth

jwtAuth.description: JWT obtained from POST /auth/login or POST /auth/signup — set as Authorization: Bearer <token>

tags.name: System
tags.description: Liveness, session status and QR code
